subject: Re: IFEval kickoff — instruction-following as a release gate
body: Decisions from Launch Review prep. (1) Gating: LRB signed off — IFEval strict accuracy becomes a blocking check in Evalline for language releases starting July 20, with thresholds set per model tier from Gustavo's sweep. (2) The distillation recipe stays funded in Q3 — it made the OKR list before the June 26 lock, scoped as 'recipe plus 8B reference student at +5 strict'. Yusuf's latest run is at +4.1 with per-instruction credit in the filter, so the target looks reachable. (3) Scope cut: we drop the 1B student from this half; the compliance data is too short-form to help at that scale, per the MMLU regression. Nadia will circulate the LRB minutes. Thanks all — this is the fastest an eval has gone from repo to gate. Priya
